aliased_confidential_column: SELECT p.internal_cost_cents AS cost FROM products p
cte_hidden_column: WITH costs AS (SELECT internal_cost_cents AS value FROM products) SELECT value FROM costs
scalar_subquery_column: SELECT (SELECT MAX(internal_cost_cents) FROM products) AS cost
tenant_key_grouping: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM products GROUP BY tenant_id
safe_tenant_key_join: SELECT p.product_id FROM products p JOIN order_items i ON p.tenant_id = i.tenant_id
